profile.name: HP 8714ES 射频网络分析仪
profile.description: 一台台式射频网络分析仪，用于在设定频率范围内进行扫频测量并观察器件的响应迹线。常用于滤波器、谐振器、电缆及其他射频器件的调试与表征，可设置输出功率、扫频参数、带宽，并利用标记和峰值搜索功能分析测量结果。
profile.description_en: A benchtop RF network analyzer used to sweep frequency and observe response traces of devices under test. It is commonly used to characterize and troubleshoot filters, resonators, cables, and other RF components, with controls for source power, sweep settings, bandwidth, markers, and peak search.
